method: authored pedestrian trace over OSM-referenced public ways; no live router response or field inspection claimed

qa: base starts and ends at canonical stops
approach and exit excluded from base
canonical and operations use same timing and access window
limits: no live accessibility certification beyond operator statement for Mazarine
no live stall, shop, seat, toilet or transport guarantee
street works, exceptional closures and barriers checked on day
